title: Crystal canyon high-resolution dedicated Imagine material set
px_per_m_definition: native width / declared metres; FAIL if < 2048

aspect_ratio_probes.note: Fresh probes this run. 16:9 and 4:3 return fewer total native pixels than 1:1, so all production materials use 1:1. Probes were prompted as ~2 m patches and are NOT production albedos. Nothing deleted.

preexisting_test_basalt.reason: After the 2048 px/m / 0.5 m rule, this tile was not prompted as a 0.5 m close-up with micro-scale detail, so four fresh 0.5 m ground variants were generated instead. File left untouched.

provenance: Embedded C2PA may identify Grok Imagine; observed metadata only, not signature/trust-chain verified.

materials.prompt: Create a genuinely new dedicated Grok Imagine video-game GROUND BASE COLOR albedo texture. The entire square is one 0.5 metre by 0.5 metre physical patch of real dark charcoal basalt, intrinsic colour near sRGB 31 32 34, filled edge to edge. Dense millimetre-scale micro-cracks and fine irregular fracture grain appropriate to a half-metre close-up, plus many tiny scattered cyan mineral chips only a few millimetres across, and a few small evenly distributed glossy cooled-flow patches. Perfectly overhead orthographic flat surface, uniform neutral shadowless illumination, no baked lighting gradients. Seamlessly tileable: left-right and top-bottom edges must continue naturally, no unique landmark, no large isolated feature. No rocks as objects, no horizon, no perspective, no scenery, no lettering, no borders, no chrome, no white specular highlights. Intrinsic albedo only; the real-time house shader supplies lighting. No reference image.
